title: Theo and the Ghost
author: Gideon Pemberton
blurb: Xanthe Voss, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
